getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.summary: The essentials to start working in GUIAA the same day.
getting-started.tip: Start on the Dashboard, register an owner with a pet, then open your first consult in GUIAA Diagnosis.
steps: Sign in with your verified veterinary account.
Check the Dashboard: today’s appointments and quick actions.
Create an owner and pet under Owners & pets.
Open GUIAA Diagnosis and complete the consult step by step.
Use Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) if you can’t find a module.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.summary: Your day at a glance: appointments, clinical activity, and shortcuts.
dashboard.tip: Jump to consults, schedule, or membership from here. Watch stock and appointment alerts.
steps: Review today’s appointments and your plan status.
Use “New consult” or the quick owner/pet registration.
Scroll to the CDS panel to continue a recent consult.
Open inventory or schedule alerts from the side menu when shown.

diagnosis.title: GUIAA Diagnosis
diagnosis.summary: Clinical consult with CDS support (it does not replace your judgment).
diagnosis.tip: Pick species → capture history → examine → document diagnosis and plan. You can export a PDF at the end.
steps: Select or create the pet and choose the correct species.
Complete chief complaint, signs, and physical exam.
Use the CDS flow to structure hypotheses and the plan (L4/L5).
Save the consult; it appears in History and on the patient chart.
On Premium, Expert Mode lets you describe the case first (emergencies).

clients.title: Owners & pets
clients.summary: Owner and patient records in one place.
clients.tip: Register the owner first, then add pets. Open the clinical chart for antecedents, problems, and timeline.
steps: Tap “New record” to create owner + pet together.
Search by name, phone, or pet in the top bar.
Open the pet sheet and tap “Open chart” for the full clinical chart.
Edit allergies, vaccines, surgeries, and problems; the timeline shows consults and lab.
Start a consult or lab interpretation from the patient.

agenda.title: Schedule
agenda.summary: Weekly appointments, statuses, and online requests.
agenda.tip: Create appointments, update status, and share the portal link so owners can request visits.
steps: Move through the week with the arrows or jump to “Today”.
Tap “New appointment” and pick patient, time, and notes.
Update status: scheduled, confirmed, completed, and so on.
Copy the portal link for owner booking requests.
Review pending requests (menu badge) and accept or decline them.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.summary: Products, stock levels, and low-stock alerts (Professional/Premium).
inventory.tip: Add products with units and a minimum stock level. Sales can deduct inventory.
steps: Add a product (medication, supply, or service).
Set quantity, unit, and low-stock threshold.
Check the summary: product count and alerts.
Adjust stock with movements when you receive supplies.

billing.title: Billing / Sales
billing.summary: Clinical receipts linked to owners, patients, and inventory (no tax invoice).
billing.tip: Create a sale, add product or service lines, then save the receipt.
steps: Tap “New sale” and select owner/patient when needed.
Add inventory products or free-text services.
Set payment method and receipt notes.
Save: the receipt appears in the list and may update stock.

reports.title: Reports
reports.tip: Pick 7, 30, or 90 days to review consults, revenue, and top products.
steps: Select the period at the top of the page.
Review KPIs for consults, sales, and inventory.
Spot top-selling products and trends.
Export CSV if you need the numbers in Excel.

history.title: Consultation history
history.summary: All previous CDS consults, with filters and a link to the pet chart.
history.tip: Filter by status, search by patient, reopen a consult, or jump to the pet’s clinical chart.
steps: Use status filters (all, draft, completed…).
Search by pet or owner name.
Open a consult to review the species form and CDS detail.
If the consult has a linked patient, use “Chart” for the clinical chart.
Start a new consult from the top button when needed.

lab.title: Images / lab
lab.summary: Interpret studies and save clinical notes linked to the patient.
lab.tip: Choose patient and study type, then paste or describe findings. You can use PDF text as context.
steps: Select or search the patient.
Choose the study type (lab, imaging, etc.).
Paste result text or write your interpretation.
Save: it appears in this module’s interpretation history.

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: Clinic details, team, booking portal, and password.
settings.tip: Only owners/admins edit the clinic. Invite your team by email with the right role.
steps: Update the clinic name and timezone.
Copy the owner booking portal link.
Invite receptionists, veterinarians, or admins by email.
Manage pending members and change your account password.
You can also replay the welcome tour from here.

membership.title: Membership
membership.summary: Plans, consult quota, and Premium features.
membership.tip: Compare Basic, Professional, and Premium. Trial limits consults; activate a plan to continue.
steps: Check your current plan and remaining consults.
Compare which modules each plan includes.
Choose monthly or yearly and complete secure checkout.
After payment, locked features unlock automatically.

profile.title: Profile
profile.summary: Your professional details and verification status.
profile.tip: Confirm name, license, and contact info are correct; verification enables clinical use.
steps: Review your veterinary details and specialty.
Check your professional license verification status.
Update phone or contact info when they change.
Go to Membership if you need to change plans.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts & support
shortcuts.summary: Move faster and get help when you need it.
shortcuts.tip: Ctrl+K opens the command palette. Support chat sits in the bottom-right corner.
steps: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) and type a module name.
In Diagnosis, N can also open a new consult (depending on context).
Open support chat for login, payments, or how-to questions.
Return to this Help center or the tour whenever you want a refresher.
